author: RAFAEL MELO REIS
purpose: Single dependency-aware closure program for engineering, scientific, data, low-level, governance and independent-replication work.

workstreams.name: execution_and_governance_wiring
workstreams.objective: Close deterministic wiring defects before widening the scientific surface.
tasks: make write-enabled validacao_real job provably workflow_dispatch-only
reconcile executable workflow inventory contract with current files
materialize gate namespace registry and closure queue receipt
workstreams.falsifier: Any declared closure step is missing, non-deterministic, or weakens fail-closed governance.

workstreams.name: canonical_background_physics_contract
workstreams.objective: Version RX-PHYSICS-CANONICAL-V2-BACKGROUND without silently choosing between reproducible divergent contracts.
tasks: declare integration tolerance and null-limit vectors
workstreams.falsifier: Null-limit, dimensional, or common-surface parity fails under the chosen versioned contract.

workstreams.name: canonical_full_covariance_likelihood
workstreams.objective: Unify G2/G5 data ordering, covariance, nuisance and likelihood manifests across competing models.
tasks: freeze data vector order and hashes
declare nuisance registry and overlap exclusions
workstreams.falsifier: Any competitor receives different data, covariance, nuisance treatment or hidden exclusions without a declared branch.

workstreams.name: rll_perturbation_physical_closure
workstreams.objective: Close A1.1 perturbation equations and initial conditions before RLL Boltzmann implementation.
tasks: freeze C07 gauge and super-horizon initial conditions
workstreams.falsifier: No globally regular, conserved and stable closure satisfies the frozen contract.

workstreams.name: independent_class_rll_backend
workstreams.objective: Implement the frozen RLL perturbation closure directly in CLASS conventions.
tasks: recover baseline with RLL sector off
workstreams.falsifier: Baseline recovery or solver stability fails.

workstreams.name: independent_camb_rll_backend
workstreams.objective: Implement the same frozen physical closure independently in CAMB conventions.
tasks: recover baseline with RLL sector off
implement RLL sector independently of CLASS
workstreams.falsifier: Baseline recovery or solver stability fails.

workstreams.name: class_camb_rll_cross_backend_parity
workstreams.objective: Cross-check independent RLL CLASS/CAMB predictions on frozen parameter vectors.
workstreams.falsifier: Cross-backend deltas exceed preregistered tolerances without an explained numerical cause.

workstreams.name: observable_binding_growth
workstreams.objective: Replace the engineering growth proxy with perturbation-derived f_sigma8 under one binding contract.
workstreams.falsifier: Perturbation-derived growth fails data/covariance or backend-parity checks.

workstreams.name: observable_binding_cmb
workstreams.objective: Promote CMB from compressed/background diagnostics to the declared perturbative likelihood route.
tasks: preserve compressed route as diagnostic only
workstreams.falsifier: Full-spectra route cannot reproduce its baseline or disagrees materially across backends.

workstreams.name: des_y6_3x2pt_and_lensing_binding
workstreams.objective: Materialize DES Y6 3x2pt likelihood, covariance, scale cuts and nuisance policy and connect it to perturbation predictions.
workstreams.falsifier: Executable official-equivalent likelihood/covariance custody cannot be established.

workstreams.name: desi_dr2_official_joint_crossblock
workstreams.objective: Reproduce the official DESI DR2 joint/cross-block authority beyond the existing local/block route.
workstreams.falsifier: Official reference likelihood/control cannot be reproduced within declared tolerance.

workstreams.name: act_dr6_lcdm_posterior_reproduction
workstreams.objective: Reproduce a frozen ACT DR6 LCDM posterior before any RLL CMB evaluation.
workstreams.falsifier: Frozen LCDM posterior cannot reproduce the declared reference envelope.

workstreams.name: h0_rd_full_boltzmann_inference_integration
workstreams.objective: Replace the lightweight r_d approximation inside formal H0/r_d inference with validated full-Boltzmann evaluation/cache.
workstreams.falsifier: Approximation replacement changes inference beyond declared numerical/physical tolerance or fails convergence.

workstreams.name: joint_multiprobe_bayesian_evidence
workstreams.objective: Run multichain/multiseed posterior and nested evidence from one frozen likelihood/prior manifest.
workstreams.falsifier: Nonconvergence, seed sensitivity or prior fragility changes the conclusion outside preregistered tolerance.

workstreams.name: robustness_ablation_recovery
workstreams.objective: Separate data-driven behavior from prior/pipeline behavior using ablations and synthetic recovery.
workstreams.falsifier: Result exists only under one fragile prior, dataset choice or hidden pipeline state.

workstreams.name: independent_replication
workstreams.objective: Reproduce core outputs in a clean environment with at least one materially independent implementation or sampler.
workstreams.falsifier: Independent implementation does not reproduce core outputs within declared tolerance.

workstreams.name: physical_termux_execution_fabric_replay
workstreams.objective: Run the exact canonical Execution Fabric plan on physical Android/Termux and compare it with Actions.
workstreams.falsifier: Physical receipt is incomplete or cross-runtime output exceeds declared parity tolerance.

workstreams.name: mf0001_mf0251_expression_execution
workstreams.objective: Execute every MF expression under its declared class without promoting geometry directly to cosmology.
workstreams.falsifier: Expression fails its formal/domain/unit contract or lacks a reproducible source.

workstreams.name: rmrcti_hidden_truth_and_real_trace_replication
workstreams.objective: Validate RMRCTI as a residual/stability diagnostic without treating it as a cosmological mechanism.
workstreams.falsifier: Routing stability does not recover hidden truth or fails independent trace reproduction.

workstreams.name: workflow_and_branch_governance_reconciliation
workstreams.objective: Make executable workflow inventory, write authority and branch maturity contracts match actual governed behavior.
tasks: preserve external-setting TOKEN_VAZIO where platform control is unverified
workstreams.falsifier: Contract reports PASS while executable files or external controls disagree.
completed_subtasks: write-enabled validacao_real job guarded by explicit workflow_dispatch
remaining_subtasks: reconcile canonical branch maturity topology with current branch histories
materialize/verify GitHub platform enforcement or preserve TOKEN_VAZIO_EXTERNAL_SETTING
separate accumulated documentation inventory drift from closure-program changes

workstreams.name: publication_and_claim_router
workstreams.objective: Map every promoted scientific sentence to evidence while preserving limitations, contradictions and negative results.
workstreams.falsifier: Any promoted sentence exceeds its evidence state.
